doc_screened_files.reason: Direct ICE site: the panic is `const_param_out_of_range` while substituting substs, so this substitution machinery is the most likely immediate fault line for the bad const generic index.

The query stack is `type_of -> type_of -> collect_mod_item_types`, and this file computes item types for const params and anonymous consts, so it is the nearest high-level caller feeding the failing substitution.

This file converts AST paths and generic arguments into `ty` forms and substs; the failure happens while resolving `S::S`, making AST-to-ty lowering a strong suspect for producing the malformed substitution.

It validates and instantiates generic argument lists, including arity and late-bound checks, and the reproducer triggers `E0107` plus a const-generic cycle, so generic-argument handling here is directly implicated.
This file builds `ty::Generics` for items and special forms like anonymous consts; a duplicate const parameter name can easily corrupt the parameter layout that later substitution depends on.

The reproducer already hits `E0403` for the duplicate generic parameter name, and late resolution owns that diagnosis and binding setup, so a bug here could leave later passes with an inconsistent parameter state.
The stack shows `TyCtxt::mk_param_from_def` during `type_of`, so the parameter-creation path in `TyCtxt` is involved in turning definitions into the substitutions that later go out of range.

This is the orchestration layer for item collection and `type_of`/predicate queries; since the crash occurs during crate item-type collection, it is a plausible integration point where malformed generics propagate onward.

The issue uses `generic_const_exprs`, and this file is responsible for inheriting predicates into opaque and const-expression contexts, so it is a plausible upstream contributor when const args are nested in type positions.

This file defines the `ty::Const` representation and helpers used throughout const-generic lowering; while not the direct crash site, it sits close to the const-parameter data flow feeding substitution.
